WebManza is an eCommerce solution that offers custom drag-and-drop website design and development, eCommerce functionality, inventory management, shipping and logistics to build businesses and easily manage their online presence.

 No.

3. How can I onboard with WebManza?
 With WebManza, you will have your site immediately! No delay, no waiting. Visit: www.webmanza.com/store-create and complete your WebManza subscription. You will instantly get access to your admin panel to start working on your website.
